resources.string: This looks like the way scammers work:
Hang up if someone is telling you what to do. Your guardian has been told. Banks and police never ask you to pay or share a code on a call.
You can continue now if you are sure.
Your guardian has released this pause.
Your guardians are told if something looks like a scam. Tap to change settings.

Co-Sign family protection notices when a bank, payment or email sign-in screen opens during a call with an unknown number, and pauses it so you can check first. It only sees what kind of screen is open. It never reads what is on the screen or what you type.
